description: Retrieve all Identity Provider users (links) for the user. Specify the optional identityProviderId to retrieve links for a particular IdP. OR Retrieve a single Identity Provider user (link).

identityProviderId.description: The unique Id of the identity provider. Specify this value to reduce the links returned to those for a particular IdP.

identityProviderUserId.description: The unique Id of the user in the 3rd party identity provider.

userId.description: The unique Id of the user.

name: retrieveIdentityProviderLink
